entries.zh: 楦鞋（用鞋楦把鞋撑开定型）；撑鞋
entries.en: to shape/stretch shoes on a last; to block shoes
entries.notes: 词头桊当为「楦」（鞋楦），词形有讹或异写；M 栏 cuý 与第二字「開」不尽吻合，依 L 栏 ahormar çapatos 定释义。

entries.en: to last a shoe; to stretch a shoe on a last
to economize, to save on expenses; to spend sparingly

entries.zh: 治煞、镇煞（驱邪禳解，驱赶魔鬼）
entries.en: to exorcise the devil; to drive out an evil spell
entries.notes: 汉字「捫煞」与 M 栏 tě soá 对应疑为「治煞/制煞」之异写，依 L 栏 ahuyentar el diablo 释义。
L 栏 Ajonjoly（今 ajonjolí）为芝麻，汉栏单书「麻」，闽南 mōa 亦通指麻类，两解并存。

entries.zh: 搬嫁粧；搬运嫁妆、陪嫁财物
entries.en: to move/transport the trousseau; dowry goods (ajuar = dote)
to fit together, to join two things

entries.zh: 装插窗扇；把窗安上（关窗、装窗）
entries.en: to fit/close windows; to set windows in place
entries.notes: 汉栏「插插」与 M 栏 bá bá 对音存疑（插当读 tshap，bá 更近「拔」），依 L 栏 ajustar ventanas 释义。

entries.zh: 算湊；核算账目以备偿付，凑算账款
